about: Test vectors for the action binding extension 0.3.0, written by generate_vectors.py from the templates in cases.json and published inputs. A0 and A0_older are signed by org-seal-1: the copy of the signatures 0.2.0 organisation seal of kind attachment, five members, sealed_at written in place, the sealed digest over the bytes with the value replaced by A. B0 and B1 are the signatures vectors' attachments; B0's copy is their seal_attachment, byte for byte. Test keys only, derived from their published seed texts: never real keys. Documents are read as JSON with no whitespace, in UTF-8, by the convention of these cases, except the texts, which are read as written.

a0.about: org-seal-1 seals A0, the attachment of DR-2099-101: the copy of the seal is its issuer_signature

a0_older.about: org-seal-1 seals the same record's earlier attachment, with the proposal, the review and the approval only: a valid signature, which says nothing about whether a later attachment exists

a1.about: org-seal-1 seals A1, the attachment of DR-2099-102

a0_org0.about: org-seal-0, superseded on 2026-10-05, signs A0 before

a0_org0_late.about: org-seal-0, stated as signing A0 after it was superseded

a0_org_x.about: org-seal-x, a key the policy does not list, signs A0

a0_person.about: person-a-1, a key in role person, signs A0

a0_witness.about: witness-a-1, a key in role witness, signs A0

a0_feb30.about: sealed_at 2026-02-30T10:00:00Z: the schema admits the form, but it is not a real UTC time

a0_before_validity.about: org-seal-1, stated as signing before the key's not_before

a0_other_profile.about: the key signed the same fields under profile dps-anchoring

a0_other_version.about: the key signed the same fields under signatures profile_version 0.3.0

a0_as_record.about: the key signed the same fields with sealed.kind record: an attachment is an attachment

a0_wrong_placeholder.about: the issuer replaced the value by 0 instead of A before digesting: not the rule, so the digest the verifier builds is another

a0_time_changed.about: signed at 10:00:00Z, the copy stating 10:05:00Z: the time is signed and under the digest

a0_moved_to_org0.about: A0's signature presented under key reference org-seal-0

a0_moved_to_a1.about: A0's copy, as it stands, for the cases to put on A1: the bytes and the identifier are another attachment's

a0_bad_signature.about: A0's copy with the last byte of its signature changed

a0_late_stage.about: org-seal-1 signs A0 with its result stage dated 10:30, the copy stating 10:00: the signature stands, and the check notes the inconsistency between the issuer's own times

seal_a0.about: the seal of A0 as the signatures profile carries it beside the attachment

seal_a0_other_time.about: org-seal-1's seal of A0 written with 10:05 in its copy, the seal stating 10:00: beside the attachment it verifies, and the copy does not agree

seal_b0.about: the signatures vectors' seal_attachment: the seal of B0

a0_early.about: TSA 1 over A0's signature value, before the time the issuer states

a0_tsa2.about: TSA 2, which the policy does not list, over A0's signature value

a0_named_a1.about: TSA 1 over A0's signature value, its subject naming DR-2099-102

a0_org0_before.about: TSA 1 over a0_org0's signature value, before org-seal-0 was revoked (2026-10-05)

a0_org0_after.about: TSA 1 over a0_org0's signature value, after org-seal-0 was revoked

a0_bad_signature.about: TSA 1 over the changed signature value, which verifies on nothing

a0_older.about: TSA 1 over A0_older's signature value: another attachment's signature, named like A0's (same record, key and kind)

a1_signed.about: TSA 1 over A1_signed's signature value: another record's signature

a0_late_stage.about: TSA 1 over A0_late_stage's signature value at 10:15, while the attachment dates its result stage 10:30

dup_decision_id.about: A0 naming decision_id twice, DR-2099-042 first and DR-2099-101 last, sealed as a reader keeping the last member reads it. Not read under this extension: such a reader verifies the signature, one keeping the first reads another record's attachment, and only the issuer can write that.

dup_sealed_at.about: A0 whose copy names sealed_at twice, 09:00 first and 10:00 last, sealed as a reader keeping the last member reads it. Not read under this extension: such a reader verifies the signature, one keeping the first builds other signed bytes.

tsas.holder: Example time-stamping authority 3 (test only; its key is RFC 9500's testRSA2048)

findings: the issuer signature, and so the attachment's bytes as issued, existed no later than 2026-10-01T10:30:00Z (tsa-example-1); not when any stage happened
no recheck or attempt is recorded
the attachment carries no issuer signature
